title: Attendance Charges on a Job in a Circle Credit Measurement
content:
## Attendance charges on the job

Attendance charges on a job under Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair are brought into the part of a
charge a Northbeam Circle Membership's benefit credit is measured against, taking one such charge and not
two.

1. Where a trip charge stands on the job in the twelve months ending on the handling day and the job stands
   scheduled, dispatched or held for parts, the attendance charges taken are that trip charge.
2. Where no trip charge stands on the job in that window, an after hours surcharge stands on it in that
   window and the job stands scheduled, dispatched or held for parts, the attendance charges taken are that
   surcharge.
3. Where neither of those holds, no attendance charges are taken.

## Only one of the two is taken

The second reading turns on no trip charge standing in the window, so a job carrying both a trip charge and
an after hours surcharge takes the trip charge alone and the surcharge is left out. A job standing in any way
other than scheduled, dispatched or held for parts takes neither, whatever attendance charges stand on it.

## Input, judgement and outcome

| Trip charge in the window | After hours surcharge in the window | Standing of the job | Attendance charges taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| 68.00 | Nothing | Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | 68.00 |
| 68.00 | 52.00 | Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | 68.00 |
| Nothing | 52.00 | Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | 52.00 |
| Nothing | Nothing | Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | Nothing |
| 68.00 | 52.00 | Any other standing | Nothing |

A trip charge and an after hours surcharge are the only two attendance charges read here, and each is taken
as it stands on the job.
